summary: Executed backend + frontend verification for EMA ARTBUILD landing page on public URL. Core API and requested UI flows passed, including multilingual switch, anchor navigation, Instagram links, responsive mobile menu, and non-configured Resend error behavior.
action_items: No blocking defects found for requested scope.
Optional code-review improvement: avoid CORS allow_credentials=True with wildcard allow_origins='*' to prevent browser credential/CORS edge-case issues.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins possibly set to '*'; this combination is not standards-compliant for credentialed browser requests and can break future auth/session flows.
test_credentials: Checked /app/memory/test_credentials.md; file exists but contains no credentials. No auth flow was in test scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://artbuild-design.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified mobile anchor scroll and no horizontal overflow at 390x844. Form submission with valid payload returns clear 503 notice when Resend is unconfigured, and no false success state.
rca of the issue: Observed console error only when submitting form without Resend configuration: backend intentionally returns HTTP 503 ("L'envoi des demandes n'est pas encore configuré."). This is expected and correctly surfaced as an error notice in UI, preventing false success.
